trend.title: Cutting cloud storage costs with a hybrid S3 + R2 setup
trend.angle: Keep hot data on S3 and cold backups on R2 to control egress and storage costs.
trend.audience: Individuals and small operators trying to lower monthly infra bills
trend.notes: Explain the concept in a way that remains valid even if exact pricing changes.
